title: Used Claude and pixel labs to create a spooky opening cutscene for my game.
author: ADHDavid

comments.author: ADHDavid
comments.body:
Claude animated everything; it took alot of prompts to get it where I wanted it, mainly because I was nitpicking. 

Then, I wanted it to render the drawings over the in-game Godot engine, which took several hours! Song is from Suno.

comments.author: RubixKuube
comments.body: Love the post-apocalyptical nursery rhyme. Really fun world building.

replies.author: ADHDavid
replies.body:
Haha, luckily the premise of the game is anti-souls like! It's a JRPG that has you slowly cutting back the grey land and healing the world. 

Or making it worse if you want.
